verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a full Admin REST API, OIDC/OAuth2 endpoints (well-known config, token introspection/revocation, dynamic client registration, device grant, client-credentials grant for machine-to-machine access), and a scriptable Admin CLI (kcadm.sh), all of which let any client—including an AI agent—drive the product programmatically without a UI. Community reports (e.g. keycloak-comm-13) note the API can be inconsistent/hard to keep idempotent in practice, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt machine-readable spec at expected paths. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt for automated discovery, and independent confirmation of API consistency for automated/idempotent use.
